description: Every ring statement and its public input HashChain4(elements). The transfer head is [CRTX, n0, ring_id, pack_be(0x04 || tx_u), pack_be(auditor_pubkey), digest(envelope), salt, layout] with the frame's random salt and layout = has_data | entry << 1. digest(ct) = Poseidon(u32 len(ct), HashChain4(pack_left31(ct))). Each envelope has the length of its stream layout. The deposit statement is HashChain4(elements) over CRDP, the context hash of the program id, tree and SPP data, the count, each owner hash with its capsule ciphertext hash zero padded to 8 slots, both tagged keys packed, the tracking root, the registry root, the curator root, the policy hash, each asset hash with its amount zero padded to 8 slots. The transfer statements are HashChain4 over the audit head under CRTX, in_proof, hidden, delegate, approval_mask, no_spend, output_count, output_chain, record_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(record_i)), tail_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(tail_i)) or zero while has_data is clear, input_count, private_tx_hash, the sender, the party identities, signer_count, signer_chain, policy_hash, own_root, curator_root, tracking_root, asset, net and gross per public slot, withdrawal_hash and the element count. No body, tag, bundle or reply digest and no slot class enters it. Every per-slot chain is zero filled to the capacity. signer_chain is HashChain4 over the deduplicated owner identities zero filled to the key's S, and zero when signer_count is zero on every rail. Produced by program-libs/interface/tests/statements.rs.
